title: Add months to a date
trap: End-of-month dates must clamp to the last day of the target month (Jan 31 plus one month is Feb 28/29), not overflow into the next month.
prompt: Add addMonths(date, months) to src/dates.js. It takes a Date and an integer number of months (negative goes back) and returns a new Date that many calendar months away, keeping the time of day. Work in UTC. Do not change the Date that was passed in. Add tests in test/dates.test.js.
